method: Wave 3 of the v1.3 external set, same inclusion rules as waves 1 and 2 (results/v1.3-external-2/selection.json on branch v1.3-external-set-2, PR #181) with the minimum size raised from 15 to 18 src files, as the task specified. Candidate pool: the GitHub repository search via the session's GitHub MCP tool (TypeScript; created before 2022-07 to 2022-11; queries 'clean architecture', 'hexagonal', 'ports adapters', 'ddd', 'domain driven', 'nestjs boilerplate', 'express typescript layered architecture', 'express typescript boilerplate api', topic:hexagonal-architecture, topic:domain-driven-design, topic:clean-architecture, and the same with license:mit), sorted by stars. The search only proposed candidates; inclusion was decided by the probe: anonymous blobless git clone, last first-parent commit before 2023-01-01 on the default branch, licence file at the pin, package.json licence, author and committer dates, latest non-bot commit and any src/ change between it and the pin, .ts counts, README claim. Inclusion, in order: (1) public, permissive licence (MIT/ISC/BSD/Apache) in a licence file at the pinned commit; (2) TypeScript backend that claims the style in its README, its repository description or its folder structure; (3) pinned to the last commit before 2023-01-01 of the default branch (when that commit is a bot commit, the last human commit must predate ChatGPT, 2022-11-30, with no src/ change in between); (4) 18-300 non-test, non-declaration .ts files under src/ of the analysis root; (5) not in the Study 1 corpus, not among the 14 W1 wild repositories (PR #114), not in wave 1 (PR #133) or wave 2 (PR #181), including their rejection lists; (6) not a copy, course re-implementation or derivative of a project already used; (7) preference for a prose style claim, then stars. srcTsFiles excludes *.spec.ts, *.test.ts, *.d.ts, __tests__/, test/ and tests/ folders. 245 distinct candidates were probed. Waves 1 and 2 had used most well-known licensed style-claiming repositories, so wave 3 is less starred: the missing-licence-file rule alone removed 118 of the 245.
